mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased demand for housing and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the past 3 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5pp, the combination signals strong demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp in 3 months
regime_hint: strong demand with labor market tightening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% over the past 3 months and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, the combination signals strong supply-side growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply-side growth with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.
